title: Compose — Revise Document — Output Schema (compose-revise-document)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-revise-document' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 DEF-11). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema baked into infra/dataverse/actions/compose-revise-document.action.json (the systemPrompt/schema author surface). The dual-channel payload — edits[] (structured, ledger-backed pending track-changes, same shape as compose-draft-alternative's ComposeDraftPayload) and comments[] (anchored review-flag comments, DEF-13 path) — becomes the opaque SessionOutput.Payload written under the `compose` disposition before render (ADR-040). Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required array, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator; spaarkeai-compose-r8 task 052 retired target_text/match_mode from edits[] — target_para_id is the targeting field and no placement path searches document text (ADR-049 I-7); comments[] keeps target_text as an ANNOTATION anchor.
$comment-required: Object-level required array (ALL four fields required — edits/comments MAY be empty arrays per intent, but the arrays themselves are always present). Property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema; 400-fails the request) — OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator enforces this. spaarkeai-compose-r8 task 052 RETIRED target_text and match_mode from edits[]: text matching is no longer a placement channel for an AI edit (ADR-049 I-7). comments[] KEEPS target_text because a review flag is an ANNOTATION anchored within its paragraph, not an edit placement — the surviving role the task-052 consumer check records (notes/052-text-search-demotion-decisions.md §1.3).

edits.description: Structured edits (pending track-changes) this revision pass proposes. Empty for a flag-risks request (comments-only). Each item names its target paragraph by identifier and carries that paragraph's full revised text — the same shape compose-draft-alternative emits.

new_text.description: The proposed replacement language — self-contained, drafting-ready prose (no placeholders, no commentary, no markup). The FULL revised text of the paragraph target_para_id names; the editor diffs it against that paragraph's current text and marks ONLY the words that changed, inserted as a pending track-change.

target_para_id.description: The bracketed [XXXXXXXX] identifier of the paragraph this edit applies to, copied VERBATIM from documentText. MUST be one of the identifiers present there (a CLOSED SET) — an identifier outside it is refused and the item dropped. This is the ONLY placement channel for an edit (spaarkeai-compose-r8 task 052, ADR-049 I-7): the editor never searches the document text for the edit's wording. Null ONLY when the paragraph genuinely cannot be identified, in which case the edit is REFUSED — there is no prose fallback.

comments.description: Anchored review-flag comments this revision pass proposes. The ONLY output for a flag-risks request (no rewrite). Each item anchors a comment to a verbatim span of documentText.

target_text.description: The exact substring of documentText this comment anchors to — copied VERBATIM so the editor can locate it.

comment.description: The review-flag text — concise, names the concrete risk or issue.

target_para_id.description: The bracketed [XXXXXXXX] identifier of the paragraph this comment anchors to, copied VERBATIM from documentText. MUST be one of the identifiers present there (a CLOSED SET) — an identifier outside it is refused and the item dropped. Null ONLY when the paragraph genuinely cannot be identified, in which case the comment hangs on target_text within the document (an ANNOTATION anchor, not an edit placement — the role ADR-049 I-7 leaves intact).

rationale.description: Concise plain-language explanation of the revision pass as a whole (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars) — names the intent applied and the concrete improvement, not a generic justification.

sources.description: Grounding for the revision. Empty array when the retrieval layer supplied no grounding — never fabricated.

id.description: The retrieval-layer identifier for the source — never fabricated.

snippet.description: A SHORT supporting excerpt from the source.
